top_signals.title: Consultancy’s multi-billion-dollar AI gamble, but where is the real return?
top_signals.summary: Consultancy firms have pumped a lot of money into frontier AI tools that have fundamentally changed tasks traditionally done by juniors. But the return on investment question lingers, writes Maria Ward-Brennan. Model ML’s platform for the consultancy market has automated manual steps such as supporting research, presentation and Excel model creation, and reviewing client-facing materials. [...]

top_signals.title: China Cuts LNG Imports as Cheap Domestic Gas Undercuts Global Prices
top_signals.summary: China is importing less liquefied natural gas despite the start of peak demand season, thanks to an abundant domestic gas supply that has led to lower prices. The Chinese national average for LNG stood at $21.97 per million British thermal units today, Bloomberg reported, almost $10 below the Japan/Korea Marker benchmark. The gas price drop comes as state-owned energy majors finish their gas stockpiling drive and begin to release gas from inventory, the report also said. The sufficient domestic supply has made spot market LNG purchases unappetizing…
